## User problem

Who needs this and what outcome should change?

## Scope

Affected workflow step, dependencies, and boundary. Read docs/PRODUCT.md and docs/ROADMAP.md. Explain how this helps build, test, or improve a target agent without requiring private source access. Distinguish target-agent behavior from development-worker behavior.

## Acceptance conditions

Use synthetic inputs and observable success, failure, authorization, and recovery outcomes. Identify any new provider cost or external side effect.

## Proposed approach

Relevant contracts and decisions, implementation boundary, and test plan. Separate existing behavior from proposals.
